paragraphs: Hello! My name is Leo, and I am nine years old. This page is about my likes and the things I do not like. I like pancakes with banana. I do not like pancakes with fish. That is terrible! I like to drink cold water after football. I am always thirsty then. I do not like hot tea. I like noodles with eggs. I do not like cold noodles.

I like to go out with my friends on Saturday. I do not like to be at home all day. I like to sail my toy boat on the pond. I do not like water on my face, so I do not swim there. I like funny clothes, like my big red hat. I do not like boring clothes. I like to draw pictures of animals. I do not like to write long stories. Do you like my red hat?

I like books about the jungle. In the jungle, there are big green trees and many animals. I like monkeys, and I like lions. I do not like snakes. I like birds, but I do not like big spiders. At night I do not like loud noise. My friend Mia likes snakes, so we are different. I like stories with a happy end. I do not like sad stories. Now I want to know about you. What do you like? What do you not like?
text.summary: Leo tells us what he likes and does not like. He talks about food, drinks, play, clothes, and the jungle, and then he asks two questions.
